description: Numeric reference fixtures for the FlowJo biex transform. Each case records forward (data->display) and inverse (display->data) values for a specific parameter set. A clean-room TypeScript implementation must match display-space values within forwardToleranceDisplay, match in-range display-space values within positiveForwardToleranceDisplay, and match inverse raw-data values within inverseToleranceData. Do not implement biex from these numbers alone — also validate against a real FlowJo .wsp file opened in FlowJo 10 to confirm gate positioning.

cases.label: flowjo_defaults
cases.notes: FlowJo 10 factory defaults for a 18-bit instrument

cases.notes: FlowJo 10 defaults with 1 negative decade (common for PI/viability)
